objective:
Goal: the file's code view is shown again. Reach it from the current page by clicking through the visible UI, by any route. Never type a URL or use the address bar.
Hint: an old tutorial said "To return to the raw code view, above the file content, click Code.", but those labels may have moved or been renamed.
When the goal is met, verify it on screen. If the page you end on has a main heading, store it as 'landed_on'; a page without a heading is fine.

actions.intent: PRIMARY: Return to the file's code view from the current page by clicking through the visible UI; role=button; text="Code" | HINTS: container=File view tabs above the file content
actions.instr: Clicking the Code tab to return to the file’s code view
